lines:
sequenceDiagram
  participant User
  participant Agent as Agent and instruction lifecycle
  participant Core as Trusted core via existing gateway
  participant Files as Authorized filesystem capability
  participant History as Existing history and context
  participant Model
  User->>Agent: Input for frozen selected Agent
  Agent->>History: Read visible context and admitted instruction metadata
  Agent->>Core: Request bounded baseline or reconciliation reads
  Core->>Files: Execute within frozen authority
  Files-->>Core: Present, absent or unavailable candidates
  Core-->>Agent: Approved observations
  Agent->>Agent: Deduplicate, scope and render within budget
  Agent->>Core: Propose instruction context delta
  Core->>History: Commit exact text and small typed metadata
  History-->>Core: Durable acknowledgement
  Core-->>Agent: Admitted context identities
  Agent->>Model: Prompt plus applicable instruction messages
  Model-->>Agent: File tool request, if available
  Agent->>Core: Invoke selected file tool
  Core->>Files: Approved read, write or edit
  Files-->>Core: Settled outcome
  Core->>History: Commit result and execution boundary
  Core-->>Agent: Successful structured touch and committed boundary
  Agent->>Agent: Coalesce pending scope changes
  Note over Agent,Model: Reconcile before next request. no redundant standalone model turn
  Note over Agent,History: Replay reuses prepared messages and settled outcomes. new requests may append file updates

data.title: Instruction baseline, file touches and durable request admission
